name: Legacy Murals (Danielle Flicek & Matt Novak)
statement:
Legacy Murals is built on over 25 years of artistic passion, transforming ordinary spaces into extraordinary works of art that inspire, connect, and leave a lasting impression. Our work is more than paint on walls; it's about creating something meaningful that people can experience, appreciate, and remember.

 We are Danielle Flicek and Matt Novak, the creative team behind Legacy Murals. Dani brings over 25 years of professional painting experience, artistic vision, and an ability to transform ideas into powerful, large-scale artwork. Matt brings a complementary set of strengths in project coordination, logistics, technical problem-solving, and hands-on execution. Together, our combined talents allow us to approach ambitious projects with creativity, efficiency, attention to detail, and the dedication needed to bring even the most challenging visions to life. We are both lift certified and carry $2 million in liability insurance, commercial auto insurance, and equipment coverage for the work we do, helping ensure every project is completed safely and professionally.

 Our experience includes creating murals for major companies as well as YouTubers with millions of followers, allowing us to deliver high-quality artwork that makes an impact for clients of every size. We believe art has the power to bring people together, strengthen communities, spark emotion, and tell stories that words alone cannot express. Every mural is an opportunity to breathe new life into a space while celebrating the people, history, and spirit that make it unique. At Legacy Murals, our mission is to elevate your space and spirit, leaving behind more than a beautiful mural, but a lasting legacy for generations to enjoy.
